title: Margherita Pizza
description: Blistered crust, crushed tomato, milky mozzarella, and fresh basil — the original pizza.
steps: Stretch the dough onto a floured tray.
Spread with crushed tomato, season with salt, and scatter torn mozzarella.
Bake hot (250°C) for about 12 minutes until the crust is blistered.
Finish with fresh basil and a drizzle of olive oil.
